title.text: Paper · Reader B: view, trust, reflow, offline, touch

n-r10.text:
R10 View settings
Pick the UI theme, page appearance, page layout and zoom in one place (reader v0.1 top bar: View button).
States: Sepia page on a light UI (popover open); Dark page with the confirming toast; phone sheet at medium detent.
Todos: C7a, U2c

n-r11.text:
R11 Dark UI theme
The F01 reader in dark chrome (proposed dark tokens); the page stays Original.
States: text selected with the mini toolbar; tweak to see the Dark page appearance.
Todos: C7a

n-r12.text:
R12 Keyboard shortcuts
Help dialog generated from the command registry, searchable, active platform only.
States: full list (search focused); no-match and filtered states in the doc.
Todos: U1b, C7a

n-r13.text:
R13 Network activity panel
Proves what left the device: requests since open, by origin and kind, and what the count proves.
States: local file at 0; file opened from a URL with range requests; warning state in the doc.
Todos: U4a

n-r14.text:
R14 Reader mode (reflow)
Reflowed, adjustable text from the structure tree, or labelled Approximate when guessed.
States: tagged with settings panel; approximate with per-block “View original page” and an image fallback page; phone for both; not-available in the doc.
Todos: U4b, U4c

n-r15.text:
R15 Offline, install and update
Install as an app, keep working offline, and update only when the user agrees.
States: install dialog; offline notice; update ready (toast + status item).
Todos: C7b

n-r16.text:
R16 Focus mode
Rail and secondary toolbar hidden; the inspector returns while something is selected. Editor top bar (Comment mode).
States: Comment mode with a highlight selected; nothing selected in the doc.
Todos: U1c

n-r17.text:
R17 Tablet reading
Desktop shell with touch rules: 44 px targets, pen hover preview, rail as a bottom sheet in portrait.
States: Comment mode with Highlight and pen hovering (Shapes and More tools on the toolbar); Read mode with the Contents sheet.
Todos: U3a

n-r18.text:
R18 Phone sheets
Contents sheet, find with the Results sheet closed (R05 owns phone find), and the More menu (View settings sheet is R10 phone).
States: outline with current section; find at 3 of 9; More with the network row.
Todos: U3a
